scope: Existing linear module and saved public inputs only
goals: Check unprojected user covariance of the current undamped query
Check exact first-query replay without changing its normalization
Measure compatibility with the already chosen training covariance family
limitations: Fixed-coefficient Gaussian working prior, not empirical covariance calibration
First iteration has no query damping; later cross-iteration error covariance is not available
48 reused conditions from 24 scenes; no independent performance inference
